findings.signal: Loose and relaxed denim remains central to Spring/Summer 2026, including baggy, barrel and flared silhouettes.
Barrel-leg jeans are a visible current Summer 2026 trend.
Summer 2026 denim coverage includes baggy shorts, comfort-focused fabrics, relaxed bootcuts and barrel jeans.
Monsoon dressing in India favours lightweight overshirts, relaxed layers and practical versatility.
Back-to-school denim marketing moved into mid-July in 2026, with low-rise styles for women and relaxed fits for men.
Denim is being used as an adaptable bridge from summer into the next season.
Independence Day falls on 15 August 2026 and Raksha Bandhan on 28 August 2026.

Spykar GSC opportunity terms include jeans for men, white jeans for men, light blue jeans, black jeans men, ankle-length jeans, cotton jeans, women's jeans, bootcut jeans, underjeans and store-near-me queries.

limitations: Trend coverage is directional editorial evidence, not search-demand volume.
The GSC export is bounded rather than exhaustive.
Keyword Planner is unavailable because GOOGLE_ADS_PLATFORM_ID is unset; no monthly-search or difficulty figures were invented.
